dsDescriptionValue.value: Additional file 4: Table S3. Supporting information related to scDD analysis. Cluster membership is indicated for significant genes from leukemic vs. pro-B comparison (against adult and pediatric BM cells), and from drug vs. ctrl (DMSO) cells in the ETS-inhibition experiments carried out in E/R+ REH cells. Includes statistical summaries for cell state comparisons related to Figs. 2 and 5.
